sources.title: OLMo2 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It is used to instantiate an OLMo2 model according to the specified arguments, defining the model architecture. Instantiating a configuration with the defaults will yield a similar configuration to that of the allenai/Olmo2-7B-1124-hf. Configuration objects inherit from PretrainedConfig and can be used to control the model outputs.

sources.snippet: We present OLMo 2, the next generation of our fully open language models. OLMo 2 includes a family of dense autoregressive language models at 7B, 13B and 32B scales with fully released artifacts -- model weights, full training data, training code and recipes, training logs and thousands of intermediate checkpoints.
